1b1(mdo): @#//bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs 
1b2(mdo): sngags dang bcas pa dus gsum gyi dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo//bcom ldan 'das rnams 
1b3(mdo): phar snang mdzad snying rje'i tsan dan dri zhim pa'i spos kyis byugs pa'i sku/zhabs rten gyi pad ma la lha dang lha ma 
1b4(mdo): yin gyi nor bu'i cod pan gyis gtugs pa rang byung sa la mdzad/bla ma 'jig rten la phan par mdzad pa/ston 
1b5(mdo): pa de bzhin gshegs pa/nyes pa dang bral ba/zhi ba'i bdag nyid can gzugs mdzes pa/mtshan gsal 
2a1(mdo): @#//ba'i gzi brjid can /sku dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/yon tan thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i lha la phyag 'tshalo
2a2(mdo): par ma rgyas pa ltar zhal gzhad de /tshems dkar zhing snyems la thags bzang bas rab tu rgyas shing snang la/nor bu dri ma med pa
2a3(mdo): ltar 'od gsal zhing mdzes te /dangs zhing gsal ba/nyi ma'i 'od zer stong 'bar ba/mang po'i 'od snang ba'i dkyil 'khor zil gyis gnon
2a4(mdo): Ithum pa'i mcheg stobs bcu dang /ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo//bdad do//oM b+he/hUM hUM/oM a/hIM hIM/shi ba shi ba/shAn ti shAn ti/sha ma sha ma
2a5(mdo): sha mA pa yA/ta thA tA nu ga ta/swA b+ha ba/a b+hA bA/sa mu da ya/a sa ma ba la/a bi ra la/ba la/a mi ba la/a ti pa la/g+hung g+hung /d+ho'u d+ho'u/b+ho'u b+h+ro'u//
2a6(mdo): b+ha du b+he du/hIM hI/braM gu ban/b+ha ban ta ka/swa ra ta/b+ho g+ha/ma hA/shAn ti ka ra/pA ba b+hi la/b+hi ta/rgya sha ka swahA////de nas dpe byad ma chad gsal ba//
2b1(mdo): yan lag thams cad rab brgyan cing //nyi ma gzhin du gsal ba po//'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyan mnga' ba//grags shing dri ma rab spangs la//
2b2(mdo): dri med skyon bral chos kyi blo//khyab bdag chen po stobs bcur ldan//rdul bral dpal dang ldan pa po//rin chen sa gzhi chen po la//pho brang rtse mo rdo rje rtse 
2b3(mdo): rgyal ba'i sras rnams gnas gyur pa//nor bu du rab 'phro zhing //'od zer dri med gsal bkod pa'i//rdo rje dkyil 'khor pho brang na//thub pa'i longs spyod sa gzhi 
2b4(mdo): la//seng ge'i khri chen yangs la bzhugs//nor bu'i dbyig gis sa gzhi dang //khri chen rab sba de nyid la//de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgyes chen gyi//phun sum tshogs 
2b5(mdo): pa brgyan ko lta//thub pa me zla nor bu'i 'od//'od zer gnon pa'i 'od ldan pa//bde blag shin tu bkra shis tshul//'od gsal skyil mo dkrung 
2b6(mdo): bcas nas//sku 'od 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor can//'od gsal rgyas pas thub dbang gis//dri med 'od zer bkye ba ni//mi g.yo rdo rje can 
2b7(mdo): zhes bya//dkyil 'khor chen po zhugs pa yi//rdo rje can dag rab btul ba//gang yin de kun dag byas nas//dkyil 'khor dri med bskor bar byed//
3a1(mdo): @#//ngan song dam tshig dri ma kun//legs par shin tu dag byas nas//srid gsum dkyil 'khor rgya che la//rnam pa du mar 'od gsal ba//'gro dang mi 'gro ma lus 
3a2(mdo): pa//bskor nas bde chen rdo rje can//rdo rje ral gri thogs pa de//cod pan ma g.yos nang du zhugs//de nas 'jigs pa'i sgra skad kyis//'gengs shing mig ni glog ltar 'gyu//
3a3(mdo): rig sngags hUM zhes sgrogs pa po//rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs byed pa//gzhin mdzes 'dzum gyis rnam par brgyan//sdig med mig rtsa rgod gyur cing //stan las langs 
3a4(mdo): te phyag 'tshal nas//legs par mchod byas smras pa ni//kye ma skye ba'i phyogs 'joms shing //bskal pa du ma'i dri ma sel//rig sngags yon tan ga sgrub byed pa//
3a5(mdo): thub mchog rnams kyis rab tu gsungs//de gzigs dge ba du ma brnyes//sangs rgyas blo gros rgyas par gyur//byang chub sems dpa' blo gros che//bskal pa gcig tu spyod 
3a6(mdo): pas kyang //rgyud mar sangs rgyas kun 'byung zhing //spyod pa du ma byung ba yi//yon tan brgya'i spos ldan 'di//thos pas spro bar mi nus so//longs spyod rgya mtsho chen po can//
3a7(mdo): byang chub sems mchog dkyil 'khor du//rgyal mchog rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i//phyir mi ldog pa'i chos chen ldan//'di thos sangs rgyas spyod pa yis//sems can 
3b1(mdo): kun gyi sdig pa rnams//ma lus rab tu bsal nas ni//blo chen dri ma med par 'gyur//zhi zhing dag byed bkra shis la//rdul med brgyan te zhi bar byed//dag zhing mya ngan 
3b2(mdo): thams cad sel//sdug bsngal thams cad nges par 'joms//dbang byed gsang sngags dam pa ste//sa steng sdig pa thams cad sel//ma smad 'bras bu nges par 
3b3(mdo): sbyin//bstan pa yin te sdang ba 'dul//nyes byas pa sel ba yi//gzungs 'di gang gis thos gyur des//sangs rgyas rnyed par dka' ba dang //ring por mi thogs thob 
3b4(mdo): par 'gyur//sgrib pa thams cad rab zhi zhing //khyab bdag nyon mongs kun sel ba//gang zhig nyon mongs zhi byed pa'i//gzungs 'di 'chang bar byed pa yis//
3b5(mdo): kun tu bzang po nyid dang ni//lag na rdo rje nyid kyang 'thob//rig sngags 'chang gi bdag po yang //'di thos pas ni thob par 'gyur//'jig rten kun na lam me ba//bcom 
3b6(mdo): ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyang //dkyil 'khor dam pa gting med pa//'di ni ji srid ma gsan par//rab zhi nyon mongs 'dul ba yi//rang byung go 'phang ma rnyes te//
3b7(mdo): rnam par dag phyir gnas gyur nas//gsan ma thag tu rnam par dag/de phyir phun sum tshogs pa dang //legs par 'dod pas brjod par bya//gzhan gyis mi thub gzungs gsan 
4a1(mdo): @#//nas;thub pa kun gyis gang brnyes pa//'khor ba 'dir ni nam du yang //bdud kyi las dang 'khrug med dang //mya ngan med cing 'thab med pa//gzungs la gnas pas thob par 'gyur//gnas kyi dam
4a2(mdo): pa thob nas kyang //thub pa dri ma med pa'i blo//gzigs pa bzang ba rnams gar gshegs pa'i//gzeng 'gro dar ni 'gro bar 'gyur//legs par 'dod pa rnams kyis ni//tshig gi mdo 'di mnyam bgyi//'on kyang zang dang nya ba la//rgyal 
4a3(mdo): bas gsungs pa'i gzungs 'dis chog //sdig pa byed cing dge la sdang //sdug pa'i rang bzhin rab 'jungs pa//gang gis thos nas de spong ba//nga'i mngon sum 'byor par 'gyur//sdig pa gzhan yang mi bya zhing //snga ma
4a4(mdo): bas kyang bshags par bya//gzungs mchog gi ni mthu stobs kyis//sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur//tshe rabs gzhan ni stong dag dang //tshe rabs bye ba phrag brgyar yang //sdig pa mi dge gang byas pa//dag 'gyur
4a5(mdo): 'di la the tsom med//yar gyi ngo ni tshes brgyad dang //de bzhin tshes ni bcwo lnga la//snyen gnas legs par lhur blangs la//gi cho ga gzhin du sangs rgyas mchod//de nas rmong ba med par yang //nyon mongs dgra ni rab 
4a6(mdo): 'joms shing //shin tu thub dka' dpe med pa//nyes pa bzlog pa'i gzungs brjod na//thub pa'i zhal gyi zla ba'i 'od//'bar ba nges par mthong bar 'gyur//des na tshogs rnams rdzogs pa yi//rgyal ba'i sras po nyid du
4a7(mdo): 'gyur;'od dpag med la mnga' ba yi//yon tan mtha' yas rab rgyas pa//bskal pa bye ba stong du yang //mtha' mi rtogs pa thob par 'gyur//de nas rdo rje 'chang gi tshig//dkyil 'khor dag na gnas rnams kyis
4a8(mdo): thos nas rgyan rnams sna tshogs pa//bcom ldan 'das la 'bul bar byed//rdo rje ral gri la sogs pa//lha bdag gsal ba thams cad dang //ri bo ti sa ri rab la//gnas pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams dang //de bzhin
4b1(mdo): dkyil 'khor chen po na//'khod pa'i rigs sngags 'chang rnams dang //ma la ya'i ri bo la//gnas shing brgyan 'bar thogs rnams dang //khyab 'jug lha chen la sogs pa//lha yi bdag po rnams dang ni//lag na 
4b2(mdo): rdo rje la sogs pa//byang chub sems dpa' stobs chen rnams//nor bu'i dpung brgyan rna bya dang //rgyan rnams rab tu g.yo ba'i lus//rab tu bskyod de langs nas ni//sdig bral mnga' bdag rgyal ba la//phyag 'tshal thal mo 
4b3(mdo): sbyar nas kyang //kun gyis sa yi dbang phyug po//thub mchog dam pa de la ni//mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dag gis bstod//mnyam nyid chos nyid bzhin nyid//shin tu rtogs pa lam me ba//dul ba brtan pa dri ma sel//dri ma 
4b4(mdo): med pa skyon bral ba//thub pa sangs rgyas shin tu zhi//'jig rten mgon po skye rgu'i bdag/de bzhin gshegs pa nyon mongs thul//de bzhin rgyal ba rdul bstsal pa//ston pa ston mdzad brtan pa ste//sdig pa med pa rdul 
4b5(mdo): dang bral//'jig rten mgon po snang mdzad pa//dag pa zhi ba zas gtsang sras//nyon mongs rab bcom phan 'dogs pa//ston pa po ste dri ma sel//spyod tshul dri med tshul bzang ba//zab pa rnam par gnon pa brtan//brtan po 
4b6(mdo): thugs brtse rnam par rgyal//mgon po de bzhin mgon mdzad pa//zhi ba'i bdag nyid zhe sdang bral//bcings pa las grol nges par grol//'jig rten kun mchog 'khra ba'i sa//bdag gir mi 'dzin dri ma med//ngan song 
4b7(mdo): sel ba dpal dang ldan//dpal mdzad de bzhin phan pa mdzad//mnyam pa med pa dpe med pa//khyab bdag nyon mongs las rnams spod//khengs pa med pa dman pa med//mnyam pa de bzhin mi mnyam mnyam//snang ba brnyes pa snang byed 
4b8(mdo): med//'jig rten snang mdzad sdig med pa//sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa ste//'jig rten kun la phan par brtson//dpa' bo zhi ba'i zhi mdzad pa//nyon mongs dgra rnams thar par mdzad//mnga' bdag thabs 
5a1(mdo): @#//mkhyen thabs che ba//sems can kun gyi 'khras lags//don yod brnyes dka' blo dang ldan//rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thub par dka'//skyob pa 'jigs sel tshangs pa ste//de bzhin sangs rgyas 
5a2(mdo): chos 'dzin pa//dpa' bo chen po 'jigs med pa//gzugs bzang mtshan rnams gsal ba ste//sum bcu rtsa gnyis mtshan mjal ba//chos kyi longs spyod rgya mtsho lags//dpe byad bzang po bkod pa yis//
5a3(mdo): spras pa'i bdag nyid ya mtshan ston//dka' ba med pa'i ston pa po//de bzhin nges pa bde sbyin pa//mthu chen yangs brgya che ba//bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams sel bar mdzad//brtson chen sbyo ba che ba ste//dgyes pa 
5a4(mdo): chen po stobs po che//mthu brnyes brtan pa chen po ste//gnas ldan dbang gis dar ba lags//gsal ba gsung ldan dpe med pa//dge ba stong pa nyid kyis rgyal//rab tu zhi ba mun pa med//blo gros chen po ches 'dzin pa//
5a5(mdo): phun sum tshogs pa ldan sa chen brnyes//'dod pa rnams ni 'dul mdzad pa//dpal mdzad dpal mnga' dpal dang ldan//dpal gyi longs spyod shin tu rgyas//bcom ldan legs bsgos sgo bar mdzad//gsung ldan 
5a6(mdo): bka shas rgyal ba'i gnas//mnyam nyid mnyam pa nyid mkhyen pa//mnyam pa nyid kyis mtshan dpag med//rab tu dgyes pa longs spyod gsal//gzhi bcas sel ba mnyam pa lags//blo dag blo ldan dri ma spangs//
5a7(mdo): gnas chen brtan par ldan pa ste//rgyas pa longs spyod dri ma med//thub pa thugs rje'i rgyan mnga' ba//bskal pa bzang po 'jigs pa'i skyabs//de bzhin 'joms med nyon mongs sel//dri med skyon bral longs spyod 
5a8(mdo): can du tshogs 'od ldan dkyil 'khor mdzes//sku bzang dge ba'i rig pa'i mchog thugs rje'i khrod ldan 'od bzang ba//mi gnas longs spyod dam pa lags//chos kyi rgyu ste yon tan gnas//brjed 'os mchod gnas longs spyod 
5b1(mdo): chen nam mkha'i mtshan te rnam dag blo//rin chen gzugs 'dra bkra shis pa//khyu mchog che spyan pa brdzi ma//rgyal ba bskyon bsal shes pa can//shes rab thabs dang ldan pa ste//'jig rten mi dge kun las 'das//dag 
5b2(mdo): par longs spyod bstan pa can//sa dang stobs dang ye shes bzod//pha rol phyin pa kun la mnga'//ting 'dzin mnyam par longs spyod pa//rnam thar sgom par mngon sum pa//gtong ba sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam//chos 
5b3(mdo): chen bde bar 'char ba lags//thams cad mkhyen pa yul las 'das//spyod yul sgrib pa mi mnga' ba//byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po rgyal//dam pa'i don te tshul che ba//shes bya'i yul rnams mtha' dag la//sgrib 
5b4(mdo): pa med par 'char ba brnyes//rigs chen 'thun par skyes pa ste//de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i gnas//khyad par brnyes pa mnyam nyid brnyes//mi mnyam sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam //don chen shin tu mthar phyin pa//nyon 
5b5(mdo): mongs bral ba thub par dka'//dge sbyong sdig pa sbyong mdzad pa//gnod pa med par bde bar 'byin//blo brgya che thams cad mkhyen//thos pa'i mtshon cha ma lus gsan//dkon pa bde ba thob 'gyur ba//mnyam pa khyad par yul 
5b6(mdo): dang ldan//'jig rten thams cad dang mgon//zhi gnas mtshon cha thub par dka'//bsam gyis mi khyab bsam yas yul//dpe med pa ste dper bya ba//'od bzang rab dgyes dpa' dang ldan//legs gsung blo'i stobs kyis 'byung//
5b7(mdo): mkhas pa zhal bzang bde sbyin pa//rab dgyes 'das pa'i spyod yul can//gsung ba chen po ye shes che//gnas chen bkra shis chen po ste//mchod par gyur pa yul las 'das//bya ba'i mtshan nyid med pa po//sangs rgyas yul du 
5b8(mdo): skyes pa ste//shes bya'i spyod yul rgya che ba//kun mkhyen longs spyod 'bras ba can//'jig rten dbang 'das spyod yul ba//kun mkhyen yul gyi snang ba ste//thabs mnga' phun sum tshogs ldan pa//rdzu 'phrul rol pa'i thabs dang ldan//chos 
6a1(mdo): @#/ O /kyai gar thabs ston pa po//rab ston yon tan sgyur mdzad pa//spyod pa ma lus 'dud par mdzad//yongs su rdzogs pa rnam par dag//sangs rgya spyo yul du skyas pa rnams sangs rgyas//bgegs byed ma
6a2(mdo): legs byed pa bcom//bdud kyi dregs pa sel bar mdzad//g.yul ngor rnam par rgyal ba brnyes//dpa' bo chen po thub mang stobs//theg pa chen po'i shing rta bcibs//blo chen rgal bar dka' ba yi//nyon mongs rgya
6a3(mdo): mtsho pha rol gshegs//theg pa chen po tshul la gnas//theg pa mchog la longs spyod pa//nyan thospa yi spyod yul can//rang rgyal las kyang 'das pa ste//sangs rgyas sa'i 'bras bur gnas//gong nas gong du 
6a4(mdo): khyad par mkhyen//khyod ni nam mkha'i gnas na bzhugs//bde 'byung sa dang zhing rnams kyi//mtshon chen dag la longs par spyod//sangs rgyas dbang po rgyas pa la//mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstod nas/de la lha
6a5(mdo): sogs tshogs rnams kyis//phyag byas mgo smad phyogs gcig 'khod//de nas dkyil 'khor chen po na//gnas pa ma lus che mer 'khod//thod du rdo rje'i thod 'ching ba//langs nas cod pan rab tu g.yos//dkyil 'khor
6a6(mdo): mthon po thams cad du//skang bar chen pos yongs bkang nas//nor bu'i rgyan ni rnam g.yo zhing //ha ha grags pa sgra sgrogs te//kye ma sangs rgyas yon tan che//bskal pa grangs med gsum gsags pa//byang chub 
6a7(mdo): sems sogs mchog rnams kyis//mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad legs par brjod//kye ma rnyed dang bde 'byung ba//mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad thos nas kyA//gang zhig klog cing rgyal la bstod//'bras bu chen po 'grub par 'gyur 
6a8(mdo): mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags bcas pa//bcom ldan 'das drung brjod na ni//sgrib dang kun nas nyon mongs dang //sdig pa thams cad dag pa 'thob//mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad mchog gton na//sgrib pa kun las nges
6b1(mdo): grol zhing /nyon mongs mtha' dag rnam par spong //shes rab chen po nyid du 'gyur//de ni longs spyod chen po dang //bde ba las kyang nyams mi 'gyur//de ni tshe rabs thams cad du//blo ldan tshe rabs dran par 
6b2(mdo): 'gyur//de nas rdo rje'i thod 'ching ba//yon tan mtha' yas sras de la//bcom ldan bdud las rgyal ba yis//mngon sum gzigs nas bka' bstsal pa//rgyal ba'i sa 'di zhi ba ste//nga la rgyal sogs 
6b3(mdo): nyon mongs 'joms//'jig rten bde ba kun las 'das//de bzhin gshegs bde mngon du phyogs//gzhan gyis mi tshugs bdud dang ni//mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad nyan byed pa//de dag nyad rnam dag bdag nyid de//sems can 
6b4(mdo): kun la bde 'dod pa//lan gcig thos pa tsam gyis kyang //de dag sa chen 'bras bu gnas//ring por mi thogs dga' 'gyur na//'chang sogs lta la ji zhig smos//de phyir rtag tu rab bsgrims la//gtan tu bde 
6b5(mdo): ba 'dod pa yis//yon tan rgya mtsho ldan pa'i gzungs//mnyan par bya zhing bcang bar bya//gang zhig nang par langs nas brjod//bdag nyid kyis kyang bton na ni//de'i don kun 'grub 'gyur la//gnod pa dang yang 
6b6(mdo): 'phrad mi 'gyur//'di ni yon kun gyi spos//dge ba phun sum tshogs sbyin pa//kun mkhyen 'bras bu bla med mchog//bde 'byung 'thob par byed pa yin//'bras bu 'byor pa ci yang rung //thob par mi 'gyur dogs 
6b7(mdo): pa med//kun mkhyen go 'phang thob gyur nas//dpe med gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur//'di ni dge zhing 'bras bur ldan//sangs rgyas sa'i 'bras bu sbyin//yid du 'ong zhing yon tan ldan//snying rje'i dri ma med sbyin pa//'di ni 
6b8(mdo): mnyam pa nyid kyi mdo//'jig rten kun gnas dga' ba ste//'jig rten kun gyi bde 'byung ba//'di dang 'dra ba gang yang med////ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa//gzungs sngags dang bcas 
7a1(mdo): @#//rdzogs s+ho////@//'phags pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/gzungs sngags dang bcas pa//byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan du dbang bskur ba de dang //'phags pa 
7a2(mdo): byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pas rang gi snying po smras pa//na ma s+t+re ya di kA nA na/sarba ta thA ga tA na sa ta A A+oM sa ra sa ra/su ru su ru/d+ha ra d+ha ra/ma ha d+ha ra/tsa ra tsa ra/ma ha tsa ra/b+ha ra 
7a3(mdo): b+ha ra/ma hA b+ha ra/kam pa kam pa//ma hA kam pa/hU ma hA/s+pha ra na/darmA/A ga kra/sa ga ra swAhA//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis//'di skad ces bka' bstsal to//kye ma gzungs chen mo 'di ni yon tan 
7a4(mdo): che ste/mtha' yas par khyab pa/bskal pa bye ba phrag mang por yang shin tu thos par dka' ba/sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad ston pa//de bzhin gshegs pa grangs med pa//'jig rten gyi khams 
7a5(mdo): thams cad snyed kyis bsnyen bkur mdzad mdzad pa/sgrib pa/sdug bsngal ba dang /'khrug pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa//rmi lam ngan pa dang /ltas ngan thams las thar par byed pa/sems 
7a6(mdo): can gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa/yongs su thar par byed pa ste//shin tu dkon pa'o//de nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa//nor bu'i cod pan 
7a7(mdo): gyis bsgyings pa/brgyan 'phreng rab tu g.yo ba rnams kyis//spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas/byang chub sems dpa'i mchog 'phags pa byams pa la/mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 
7a8(mdo): kyis mngon par bstod pa dpa' bo chen po thabs brnyes pa//rgyal 'tshab ma'i bdag po ste//'jig rten bdag por rnam par gsal//dar ba chen po mngon par rgyas/
7b1(mdo): mtshan chen stobs ldan che ba ste//de bzhin yangs shing rdul dang bral//dbang chen rtse ltar 'od ldan pa//sa'i dbang phyug rnam par gnon//rgyal chen mtshon cha brgya pa ste//mtshon cha chen po'i 
7b2(mdo): rdo rje'i mtshon//yon tan 'od rgyas bsgyings pa ste//nor bu'i rna cha'i rgyan thogs pa//srid gsum dag na sba ba'i sku//ma rgya mtsho lta bu'i spyod yul can//lhun po zla 'byin ti se yi//rtse nas dkyil 
7b3(mdo): 'khor 'char ba po//dkyil 'khor chen po longs spyod pa//rab tu dga' bde bzhin des//yongs su dga' ldan chen po'i lha//che ba'i lha rnams kun gyi mchog//sangs rgyas gdung rgyud rgyas mdzad cing//sangs rgyas 
7b4(mdo): dkyil 'khor rgyan dang ldan//sangs rgyas longs spyod longs par spyod//sangs rgyas bstan pa ston pa po//ti se zla 'byin bzhin du yangs//sa'i dbang phyug bde mdzad pa//pad ma 'dab stong rtse mo can//
7b5(mdo): rdo rje pad ma legs par skyes//chos kyi longs spyod longs par spyod //sa dang mnyam pa thub par dka'//snang bar byed par 'byung ba po//srid gsum ye shes nyi ma lags//gtso bo chen po cher
